release_rule: All stages must pass on one coherent action/carrier/readout chain before merge to main.

action_policy.reason: V4-002 through V4-005 pass their declared gates on this exact incumbent. It already contains the direct-prong transfer and matching parallel-frame clock correction. Keep it frozen for V4-006 unless an independently validated repair requires action changes.

current_movement_incumbent.admission_scope: V4-001–005 research gates only. Complete cell translation remains open; canonical V40 and public main are unchanged.

stages.summary: Exact localized rest solution rebuilt on the clean branch with only standard Lean foundations.

Rechecked existing declared stability gate: both copies and all 16 declared launches are bounded over 100 cycles, with exact-rest, conservation and box/timestep controls. The experimental V4-006 contrast preparation is not this gate's admitted launch family.
Rechecked fixed native local two-layer readout, four complex components per copy, controlled local remainder and no fitted evolving frame. This is not yet a claim of full cell translation.
Rechecked the unchanged admitted V4-003 readout's cubical rotation, density, 2pi sign and 4pi return. The theorem is scoped to that readout.
Rechecked short-time signed native transport and center-resolved action-derived current on the same frozen action and tested readout. The finite cell crossing is V4-006.
